:::{#def-profile-loglik}
#### Profile log-likelihood

Split a parameter vector into $(\interest, \nuisance)$,
and for each fixed value of $\interest$
let $\hnuisance(\interest)$ maximize $\llik(\interest, \nuisance)$ over $\nuisance$.
The **profile log-likelihood** of $\interest$ is

$$\llik_p(\interest) \eqdef \llik\paren{\interest, \hnuisance(\interest)}.$$

:::
